findings.issue: Common noun הַצָּרַעַת is left as the transliteration tsaráat; a non-name lemma stays Spanish.
One object, the bird modified by feminine adjective הַחַיָּה, is split into masculine el pájaro and a separate feminine la viva.

notes: Rociará, siete veces, lo purificará, and enviará match the 3ms sequential verbs; faces keeps the plural of פני.
